mil5.3.2:1.3: Puna ca bhaṇatha: Aggikkhandhūpame dhammapariyāye bhaññamāne saṭṭhimattānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ uṇhalohitaṃ mukhato uggatan-ti.
mil5.3.2:1.4: Aggikkhandhūpamaṃ bhante dhammapariyāyaṃ desentena Tathāgatena saṭṭhimattānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ hitam-apanetvā ahitam-upadahitaṃ.
mil5.3.2:1.5: Yadi bhante Nāgasena Tathāgato sabbasattānaṃ ahitam-apanetvā hitam-upadahati, tena hi: Aggikkhandhūpame dhammapariyāye bhaññamāne saṭṭhimattānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ uṇhalohitaṃ mukhato uggatan-ti yaṃ vacanaṃ taṃ micchā.
mil5.3.2:1.6: Yadi Aggikkhandhūpame dhammapariyāye bhaññamāne saṭṭhimattānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ uṇhalohitaṃ mukhato uggataṃ, tena hi: Tathāgato sabbasattānaṃ ahitam-apanetvā hitam-upadahatīti tam-pi vacanaṃ micchā.
mil5.3.2:1.7: Ayam pi ubhatokoṭiko pañho tavānuppatto, so tayā nibbāhitabbo ti.
mil5.3.2:2.1: Tathāgato mahārāja sabbasattānaṃ ahitam-apanetvā hitam-upadahati. Aggikkhandhūpame ca dhammapariyāye bhaññamāne saṭṭhimattānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ uṇhalohitaṃ mukhato uggataṃ. Tañ-ca pana na Tathāgatassa katena, tesaṃ yeva attano katenāti. -
mil5.3.2:3.1: Yadi bhante Nāgasena Tathāgato Aggikkhandhūpamaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ na bhāseyya, api nu tesaṃ uṇhalohitaṃ mukhato uggaccheyyāti. -
mil5.3.2:3.2: Na hi mahārāja, micchā paṭipannānaṃ tesaṃ Bhagavato dhammapariyāyaṃ sutvā pariḷāho kāye uppajji, tena tesaṃ pariḷāhena uṇhalohitaṃ mukhato uggatan-ti. -
mil5.3.2:3.3: Tena hi bhante Nāgasena Tathāgatass' eva katena tesaṃ uṇhalohitaṃ mukhato uggataṃ, Tathāgato yeva tattha adhikāro tesaṃ nāsanāya. Yathā nāma bhante Nāgasena ahi vammīkaṃ paviseyya, ath' aññataro paṃsukāmo puriso vammīkaṃ bhinditvā paṃsuṃ hareyya, tassa paṃsuharaṇena vammīkassa susiraṃ pidaheyya, atha tatth' eva so assāsaṃ alabhamāno mareyya; nanu so bhante ahi tassa purisassa katena maraṇam-patto ti. -
mil5.3.2:3.5: Evam-eva kho bhante Nāgasena Tathāgato yeva tattha adhikāro tesaṃ nāsanāyāti.
mil5.3.2:4.1: Tathāgato mahārāja dhammaṃ desayamāno anunayapaṭighaṃ na karoti, anunaya-paṭighavippamutto dhammaṃ deseti, evaṃ dhamme desiyamāne ye tattha sammā paṭipannā te bujjhanti,
mil5.3.2:4.2: ye pana micchā paṭipannā te patanti.
mil5.3.2:4.3: Yathā mahārāja purisassa ambaṃ va jambuṃ vā madhukaṃ vā cālayamānassa yāni tattha phalāni sārāni daḷhabandhanāni tāni tatth' eva accutāni tiṭṭhanti, yāni pana tattha phalāni pūtivaṇṭamūlāni dubbalabandhanāni tāni patanti;
mil5.3.2:4.4: evam-eva kho mahārāja Tathāgato dhammaṃ desayamāno anunaya-paṭighaṃ na karoti, anunayapaṭighavippamutto dhammaṃ deseti, evaṃ dhamme desiyamāne ye tattha sammā paṭipannā te bujjhanti;
mil5.3.2:4.5: ye pana micchā paṭipannā te patanti.
mil5.3.2:5.1: Yathā vā pana mahārāja kassako dhaññaṃ ropetukāmo khettaṃ kasati, tassa kasantassa anekasatasahassāni tiṇāni maranti;
mil5.3.2:5.2: evameva kho mahārāja Tathāgato paripakkamānase satte bodhento anunaya-paṭighavippamutto dhammaṃ deseti, evaṃ dhamme desiyamāne ye tattha sammā paṭipannā te bujjhanti,
mil5.3.2:5.3: ye pana micchā paṭipannā te tiṇāni viya maranti.
mil5.3.2:6.1: Yathā vā pana mahārāja manussā rasahetu yante ucchuṃ pīḷayanti, tesaṃ ucchuṃ pīḷayamānānaṃ ye tattha yantamukhagatā kimayo te pīliyanti;
mil5.3.2:6.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja Tathāgato paripakkamānase satte bodhento dhammayantam-abhipīḷayati, ye tattha micchā paṭipannā te kimī viya marantīti. -
mil5.3.2:7.1: Nanu bhante Nāgasena te bhikkhū tāya dhammadesanāya patitā ti. -
mil5.3.2:7.2: Api nu kho mahārāja tacchako rukkhaṃ rakkhanto ujukaṃ parisuddhaṃ karotīti. -
mil5.3.2:7.3: Na hi bhante, vajjanīyaṃ bhante apanetvā evam-idaṃ tacchako rukkhaṃ ujukaṃ parisuddhaṃ karotīti. -
mil5.3.2:7.4: Evam-eva kho mahārāja Tathāgato parisaṃ rakkhanto na sakkoti bodhaneyye satte bodhetuṃ, micchā paṭipanne pana satte apanetvā evam-ete bodhaneyye satte bodheti. Attakatena pana te mahārāja micchā paṭipannā patanti.
mil5.3.2:8.1: Yathā mahārāja kadalī veḷu assatarī attajena haññati,
mil5.3.2:8.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja ye te micchā paṭipannā te attakatena haññanti patanti.
mil5.3.2:9.1: Yathā mahārāja corā attakatena cakkhuppāṭanaṃ sūlāropanaṃ sīsacchedanaṃ pāpuṇanti,
mil5.3.2:9.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja ye te micchā paṭipannā te attakatena haññanti Jinasāsanā patanti.
mil5.3.2:9.3: Yesaṃ mahārāja saṭṭhimattānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ uṇhalohitaṃ mukhato uggataṃ tesaṃ taṃ n' eva Bhagavato katena na paresaṃ katena, atha kho attano yeva katena.
mil5.3.2:10.1: Yathā mahārāja puriso sabbajanassa amataṃ dadeyya, te taṃ amataṃ asitvā arogā dīghāyukā sabbītito parimucceyyuṃ, ath' aññataro puriso durupacārena taṃ asitvā maraṇaṃ pāpuṇeyya; api nu kho so mahārāja amatadāyako puriso tatonidānaṃ kiñci apuññaṃ āpajjeyyāti.
mil5.3.2:10.3: Evam-eva kho mahārāja Tathāgato dasasahassimhi lokadhātuyā devamanussānaṃ amataṃ dhammadānaṃ deti, ye te sattā bhabbā te dhammāmatena bujjhanti,
mil5.3.2:10.4: ye pana te sattā abhabbā te dhammāmatena haññanti patanti.
mil5.3.2:10.5: Bhojanaṃ mahārāja sabbasattānaṃ jīvitaṃ rakkhati, tam-ekacce bhuñjitvā visūcikāya maranti, api nu kho so mahārāja bhojanadāyako puriso tatonidānaṃ kiñci apuññaṃ āpajjeyyāti.-
mil5.3.2:10.7: Evam-eva kho mahārāja Tathāgato dasasahassimhi lokadhātuyā devamanussānaṃ amataṃ dhammadānaṃ deti, ye te sattā bhabbā te dhammāmatena bujjhanti,
mil5.3.2:10.8: ye pana te sattā abhabbā te dhammāmatena haññanti patantīti. -
mil5.3.2:10.9: Sādhu bhante Nāgasena, evam-etaṃ, tathā sampaṭicchāmīti.
